facts.business: Muthoot Capital Services Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) providing vehicle finance including two-wheeler loans, new and used car loans, commercial vehicle loans, construction equipment loans, loyalty loans, and accepting fixed deposits.
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during FY 2025-26 were in compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI Listing Regulations, approved by the Audit Committee and, where required, by shareholders via Postal Ballot (June 15, 2024) for transactions with Muthoot Bankers (windmill business) and Muthoot Fincorp Limited (cash remittance, space sharing, rent deposits) for a five-year period. Transactions were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. Details are in Annexure IV (Form AOC-2) and Notes to Financial Statements (Ind AS 24).
